title: Technoir Wallpaper Engine Pipeline Schema
description: Render pipeline configurations. Each property name is the pipeline label used by the engine.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$.description: Render pipeline configuration. Shader interfaces and pipeline layout are inspected from the shader by the engine; this configuration describes fixed-function state and information Naga cannot determine from the shader alone.

shader.description: Path to the WGSL or WESL shader file relative to the plugin's shaders/ directory.

entry_points.description: Explicit shader entry points. Omit this when the shader contains exactly one entry point for each required stage; the engine will select those automatically.

vertex.description: Vertex-stage entry point. Normally omitted when Naga finds exactly one vertex entry point.

fragment.description: Fragment-stage entry point. Normally omitted when Naga finds exactly one fragment entry point.

constants.description: Values for pipeline-overridable shader constants. A key is either the constant identifier or the decimal @id value assigned to the constant. Naga can determine which constants exist, but cannot determine which value this pipeline intends to use.

^(?:[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|[0-9]+)$.description: Concrete scalar value supplied to the shader when the pipeline is compiled.

vertex_buffers.description: Actual memory layouts of vertex buffers. This is required because shader reflection can determine vertex input locations and types, but cannot determine the CPU/GPU buffer stride, attribute byte offsets, buffer slot, or whether a buffer advances per vertex or per instance. Use [] when the vertex shader does not consume vertex-buffer inputs.

targets.description: Color-target state for fragment outputs. The engine supplies the actual attachment format from the host render target. The number and locations of fragment outputs are validated against the shader. Use [] for a vertex-only/depth-only pipeline.

oneOf.description: No color attachment is used at this target slot.

slot.description: Vertex-buffer slot used by the render pass.

array_stride.description: Size in bytes of one vertex or instance record.

step_mode.description: Whether the buffer advances once for every vertex or once for every instance.

VertexAttribute.description: One vertex attribute mapped to a shader input location.

format.description: Physical vertex-attribute format in GPU memory. This must be compatible with the reflected shader input type.

offset.description: Byte offset of this attribute from the beginning of one vertex or instance record.

shader_location.description: Shader input location consumed by the vertex entry point.

ColorTarget.description: Fixed-function state for one color output. The render-target format is selected by the host and is not configured here.

oneOf.description: Named blend behavior. Opaque performs an overwrite with blending disabled; Alpha is conventional straight-alpha blending; PremultipliedAlpha assumes premultiplied color; Additive accumulates source color; Replace uses an explicit replace blend state.

write_mask.description: Color channels written by the fragment stage. Omission means all channels are written.

PrimitiveState.description: Primitive assembly and rasterization state. Topology is required because the shader does not determine whether the draw is interpreted as points, lines, or triangles.

topology.description: How vertices supplied by the draw call are assembled into primitives.

strip_index_format.description: Index format used for indexed strip primitives. Omit when drawing non-strip primitives or non-indexed strips.

front_face.description: Winding order considered front-facing. This becomes important when face culling is enabled.

unclipped_depth.description: Allows depth values outside the normal clip range. Requires the host device feature for depth clip control.

polygon_mode.description: Rasterization mode. Line and Point require corresponding host device features.

conservative.description: Enables conservative rasterization. Requires the corresponding host device feature and has additional primitive-mode restrictions.

DepthStencilState.description: Depth and/or stencil state. The depth/stencil attachment format must match the attachment selected by the host render pass.

format.description: Depth/stencil attachment format. If the engine owns a fixed depth/stencil format, this field can be removed from the plugin-facing schema and supplied by the host instead.

write_enabled.description: Whether passing fragments write a new depth value.

compare.description: Comparison performed between the fragment depth and the existing depth value.

read_mask.description: Mask applied to stencil values when reading. Only the low 8 bits are used.

write_mask.description: Mask applied to stencil values when writing. Only the low 8 bits are used.

compare.description: Comparison used by the stencil test.

fail_op.description: Stencil operation performed when the stencil test fails.

depth_fail_op.description: Stencil operation performed when stencil passes but the depth test fails.

pass_op.description: Stencil operation performed when both applicable tests pass.

MultisampleState.description: Multisampling state. The sample count must match the render target created by the host.

count.description: Number of samples calculated per pixel. Must match the render target and any resolve configuration.

alpha_to_coverage_enabled.description: Uses fragment alpha to determine sample coverage. Normally relevant only for multisampled rendering.

CustomBlendState.description: Explicit blend state. Factors using Constant or OneMinusConstant also require a host-side blend constant to be supplied during the render pass. Factors using Src1 require dual-source blending support and are restricted to the first render target.

BlendComponent.description: One color or alpha blend equation.

BlendFactor.description: Blend factor. Src1-based factors require dual-source blending support and are only valid on the first render target.
